name: pkg-mismatch
about: Packages of other updates beside the current ones (issue #24): gamelab-stampfake carries two package check modules exactly as tools/build.py generates them. HWP-stampfake is one from before update stamps (it only calls HWP::Packages::Mismatch); HWP-stampnew is a stamped one of an older update (library 000000000001, update 2026-10-01). The checks log the mismatch, and in town the player is told each odd package's update next to the running library's; the real package still passes its own check and logs its update.

steps.name: the real package matches, with its update

steps.pattern: \[HWP:core\] package HWP-stampfake was built with library 000000000000 but library [0-9a-f]{12} loaded
steps.name: the unstamped other build is logged

steps.pattern: \[HWP:core\] package HWP-stampnew was built with library 000000000001 but library [0-9a-f]{12} loaded
steps.name: the stamped other build is logged

steps.pattern: \[HWP\] HammerwatchPlus packages from different updates are enabled together, so some mods may misbehave\. The library running is from \d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \([0-9a-f]{7,}\+?\); HWP-stampnew 2026-10-01 \(0000000\), older; HWP-stampfake an update from before update stamps, older\. Update them all
steps.name: the player is told each package's update
